'''Brittney Paz''' is an attorney admitted to the Connecticut State BAR. Ms. Paz is a co-partner along with Norm Pattis at Pattis & Paz. Ms. Paz was the Free Speech Systems, LLC corporate representative in the deposition by Kaster Lynch Farrar & Ball, LLP. <ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YIczy1avGDs</ref>
